parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly made of aluminum, typically circular with three blades, forming the main air-moving component of the fan.
parts.Functional_description: It converts electrical energy into mechanical motion to move air through the fan housing, providing ventilation or cooling.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when powered by a motor, generating airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main housing or frame of the fan, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support and protection for the internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, directs airflow, and allows for mounting on walls or other surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as a fixed support structure.
